_note: Prologue, the storm night over Brindlewick (plan item 1410). Since 1.3.2 it plays when the Wayfarer first reaches Brindlewick after the opening in the ferns (Opening, Overworld.village_story). One text box (the three small lights of the storm are met in the ferns, Opening.MEET_LINE): the lore that was cut here (the cartographers, the Hush, Mirela's lost Rift) is told by Aldo and on Mirela's first map page.

say: Last night a storm tore the sky. Rifts opened over Veydal.
